Film · Six Frames

The Common Things

平常之事

在 Bilibili 观看: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1pN4UztEiQ

six frames, twenty seconds each

voice and visuals transform the common
into something almost sacred

under the metallic masks
the ordinary turns dreamlike

a quiet meditation on identity, repetition,
and the beauty hidden in plain sight

directed by Smart Chen

voice-over narration by Luccas Perez

special thanks to Franciscus Chang, Luccas Perez, Nathan Ren, Ian De Leon and Will Chen

10/2025

Luccas Perez:

Then there’s me,

Running, chasing

It's always something

Whether it was getting out of Broward

Whether it was getting out of Atlantis

Getting into college

Getting to this music

Connecting with my dead

Trying to inspire my youngins

Make a mannequin out of me

It's always something

But truly, it’s nothing

I do more and more, and remain empty

The pursuit of knowledge, power, money, fame, self-fulfillment, some sense of satisfaction, simply to be satiated-

I am a husk, my hunger is unsatiable

However, my resolve is ever unbreakable

I don’t think I'll ever find what I’m chasing, and that’s okay
